basic_info.description: Prime Russian Hill | Updated 1BD + Flexible 2BD | Parking & Storage. Spacious and sun-filled residence featuring hardwood floors, designer lighting, and charming old-world details throughout. The large primary bedroom offers a deep closet, while the bright windowed bath adds classic appeal. A well-equipped kitchen includes ample cabinetry and stainless steel appliances.    The formal dining room flows into a corner living room that can easily be reimagined as a second bedroom or study, offering flexibility to suit your needs.    Additional highlights include one parking space, common laundry, and dedicated storage.    Situated in the heart of Russian Hill, with Nob Hill, Pacific Heights, the Marina, and North Beach just moments away. Excellent walk and transit scores, with convenient access to BART, light rail, cable cars, and bus lines.
